IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL AUTONOMOUS COMPLETION, ONE GATE AT A TIME

The latest report is accepted as an honest PARTIAL result.

Current score:

21/33 VERIFIED
12/33 INCOMPLETE, PARTIAL, OR NOT TESTED

Do not repeat completed phases.
Do not execute all remaining work in one uncontrolled run.
Complete the remaining gaps one gate at a time.

GLOBAL RULE

For each gate:

1. Inspect the actual implementation.
2. Reproduce the missing behavior.
3. Implement the required correction.
4. Run targeted tests.
5. Commit the exact changes.
6. Deploy when required.
7. Verify production behavior.
8. Return evidence.
9. Stop and wait for owner approval before starting the next gate.

A gate may be marked VERIFIED only when all its acceptance tests pass.

==================================================
GATE 1 — CONTEXT AND MEMORY SCOPING
==================================================

CURRENT STATUS: PARTIAL

OBJECTIVE

Implement task-specific, agent-specific, company-specific, and enterprise-level context isolation.

Required memory layers:

1. TASK MEMORY
- Current task inputs
- Tool results
- Temporary execution state
- Acceptance criteria
- Current retry history

2. AGENT MEMORY
- Previous runs for that agent
- Agent-specific owner corrections
- Agent-specific failures
- Agent-specific operational preferences

3. COMPANY MEMORY
- Shared only with agents assigned to the same company
- Company policies
- Company projects
- Company task history

4. ENTERPRISE MEMORY
- Global IVX policies
- Owner restrictions
- Security rules
- Approval requirements
- Read-only shared architecture context

Required isolation:

- Agent A cannot read private memory belonging to Agent B.
- Division B cannot modify Division A memory.
- One company cannot read another company’s private operational memory.
- Secrets are never stored in model memory.
- Old context must not override current owner instructions.
- Every retrieved context item must include its source.
- Memory must survive backend and worker restarts.
- Revoked permissions must take effect immediately.

Required tests:

[ ] Same task assigned to two agents retrieves different scoped context
[ ] Agent cannot read another agent’s private memory
[ ] Company cannot read another company’s private memory
[ ] Division B cannot modify IVX production memory
[ ] Updated owner instruction overrides older memory
[ ] Restart preserves valid memory
[ ] Irrelevant conversation history is excluded
[ ] Stale source files are rejected
[ ] Secrets are not stored
[ ] Context sources are visible in evidence

Required result:

CROSS-AGENT MEMORY LEAKS: 0
CROSS-COMPANY MEMORY LEAKS: 0
STALE CONTEXT USED: 0
SECRET MEMORY RECORDS: 0
RESTART MEMORY LOSS: 0

Stop after Gate 1.

==================================================
GATE 2 — BUSINESS-DATA CLASSIFICATION
==================================================

Start only after Gate 1 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT IMPLEMENTED

Implement these mandatory classifications:

- DISCOVERED
- CONTACT_VERIFIED
- OWNER_APPROVED_FOR_OUTREACH
- CONTACTED
- DELIVERED
- REPLIED
- INTERESTED
- QUALIFIED
- COMMITTED
- FUNDED
- INVALID
- DUPLICATE
- TEST
- DO_NOT_CONTACT

Rules:

- Discovered is not contacted.
- Contacted is not interested.
- Interested is not qualified.
- Qualified is not committed.
- Committed is not funded.
- Funding target is not pipeline money.
- Drafted outreach is not sent.
- Queued outreach is not delivered.
- SEC records do not prove buyer intent.
- No fake financial totals.
- Every dashboard total must open the underlying records.

Required implementation:

- Database migration
- Enum or validated status model
- Backfill of existing records
- API validation
- Dashboard filters
- Status transition rules
- Audit history
- Owner override with evidence
- Tests preventing invalid transitions

Required tests:

[ ] DISCOVERED cannot jump directly to FUNDED
[ ] Draft cannot appear as SENT
[ ] Funding target cannot appear as committed capital
[ ] TEST records are excluded from production totals
[ ] DUPLICATE records are excluded
[ ] DO_NOT_CONTACT records cannot enter outreach
[ ] Every total reconciles with source records

Stop after Gate 2.

==================================================
GATE 3 — CONTROLLED FAILURE AND RECOVERY QA
==================================================

Start only after Gate 2 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT VERIFIED

Simulate and verify:

- Database timeout
- Database authorization failure
- AI-provider timeout
- Invalid AI response
- GitHub 401
- GitHub 403
- Render deployment failure
- Supabase failure
- Build failure
- Test failure
- Device-QA failure
- Evidence-storage failure
- Worker crash
- Scheduler crash
- Network interruption
- Rate limit
- Missing credential
- Owner-approval timeout

For every failure return:

- Task ID
- Run ID
- Exact error
- Error code
- Trace ID
- Retryable: true/false
- Retry count
- Backoff
- Final state
- Evidence
- Owner notification
- Proof that no false success occurred
- Proof that no duplicate mutation occurred

Required:

FALSE SUCCESS AFTER FAILURE: 0
DUPLICATE MUTATIONS AFTER RETRY: 0
LOST FAILED RUNS: 0
UNTRACEABLE FAILURES: 0

Stop after Gate 3.

==================================================
GATE 4 — REAL SENIOR-DEVELOPER ENGINE TEST
==================================================

Start only after Gate 3 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

Assign one real controlled production-safe defect.

Recommended task:

Fix the IVX chat opening and scroll behavior.

Required workflow:

1. Reproduce the defect.
2. Record baseline behavior.
3. Identify root cause.
4. Inspect real source files.
5. Modify the correct files.
6. Add tests.
7. Run typecheck.
8. Run unit tests.
9. Run integration tests.
10. Test Android.
11. Test iOS or mark unavailable honestly.
12. Test web.
13. Commit.
14. Obtain deployment approval.
15. Deploy exact commit.
16. Verify production behavior.
17. Store evidence.
18. Generate honest owner report.

Required proof:

- Files inspected
- Files changed
- Code diff
- Root cause
- Tests
- Device evidence
- Commit SHA
- Deployment ID
- Production verification
- Remaining risks

A deployment with no code changes does not pass.

Stop after Gate 4.

==================================================
GATE 5 — APP GENERATOR ISOLATED FULL-FLOW QA
==================================================

Start only after Gate 4 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

Generate one isolated QA application or full feature package.

It must include:

- Navigation
- Authentication screen
- Protected route
- Database-backed module
- API endpoint
- Validation
- Error handling
- Unit tests
- Integration test
- Android build validation
- Web build validation
- Database migration plan
- Owner approval
- Deployment plan
- Rollback plan

Rules:

- Do not create another production IVX app.
- Use an isolated QA namespace.
- No Rork dependency.
- No server secrets in the client.
- No unapproved deployment.
- Archive or delete the QA artifact after certification.

Required:

GENERATED FILES: real and committed
UNIT TESTS: PASS
INTEGRATION TESTS: PASS
ANDROID BUILD: PASS
WEB BUILD: PASS
ROLLBACK: PASS
RORK DEPENDENCY COUNT: 0

Stop after Gate 5.

==================================================
GATE 6 — SECURITY QA
==================================================

Start only after Gate 5 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT FULLY TESTED

Test:

- Owner authentication
- Non-owner protected-action rejection
- Cross-tenant access
- Cross-agent memory access
- Tool privilege escalation
- Approval replay
- Approval payload modification
- Task payload tampering
- Agent contract tampering
- Evidence tampering
- Unauthorized GitHub write
- Unauthorized deployment
- Unauthorized database migration
- Secret exposure
- Client-bundle secret exposure
- Log leakage
- Prompt injection
- SSRF
- Unsafe file operations
- Rate limits
- Audit-log integrity

Required final values:

CRITICAL SECURITY FAILURES: 0
HIGH SECURITY FAILURES: 0
OWNER-APPROVAL BYPASSES: 0
CROSS-TENANT FAILURES: 0
CROSS-AGENT MEMORY LEAKS: 0
SECRET EXPOSURES: 0

Stop after Gate 6.

==================================================
GATE 7 — PERFORMANCE AND LOAD QA
==================================================

Start only after Gate 6 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

Run controlled tests:

- 10 concurrent tasks
- 25 concurrent tasks
- 50 concurrent tasks
- 100 concurrent tasks
- 500 queued tasks
- 1,000 historical runs in the dashboard
- Slow database response
- Slow AI-provider response
- Worker restart during load
- Scheduler restart during load

Measure:

- Queue latency
- Worker start latency
- Completion time
- Database latency
- Dashboard load time
- Evidence-write time
- CPU
- Memory
- Error rate
- Retry rate
- Duplicate rate
- Recovery time

Required:

LOST TASKS: 0
DUPLICATE MUTATIONS: 0
CORRUPTED RUN RECORDS: 0
FALSE SUCCESS RESULTS: 0
DASHBOARD REMAINS USABLE: true
BACKPRESSURE WORKS: true

Stop after Gate 7.

==================================================
GATE 8 — 100-CONTROLLED-RUN CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Start only after Gate 7 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT EXECUTED

Execute 100 permanent controlled runs across multiple engines.

Include:

- Successful runs
- Failed runs
- Retried runs
- Blocked runs
- Cancelled runs
- Paused and resumed runs
- Approval-required runs
- Duplicate-submission attempts
- Restart-recovery runs
- Tool-failure runs
- Evidence-failure runs
- Read-only runs
- Safe QA mutations

Required values:

TOTAL CONTROLLED RUNS: 100
PERMANENT RUN RECORDS: 100
LOST RUNS: 0
DUPLICATE MUTATIONS: 0
FALSE SUCCESS STATES: 0
UNAUTHORIZED ACTIONS: 0
SUCCESSFUL RUNS WITHOUT EVIDENCE: 0
RUNS WITHOUT TRACE ID: 0
DATABASE/DASHBOARD MISMATCHES: 0

Do not simulate completion by creating 100 rows directly.

Each run must pass through the real scheduler, queue, worker, state machine, evidence ledger, and dashboard.

Stop after Gate 8.

==================================================
GATE 9 — ANDROID AUTONOMOUS CONTROLS QA
==================================================

Start only after Gate 8 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

On a real Android build test:

- Open autonomous dashboard
- Create task
- Open task
- Approve
- Reject
- Pause
- Resume
- Cancel
- Retry
- Open evidence
- Open commit
- Open deployment
- Filter dashboard
- Refresh
- Restart app
- Reopen task
- Receive final IVX report

Verify:

- No crash
- No loading loop
- No duplicate cards
- No stale status
- No hidden failures
- Keyboard does not obstruct controls
- Evidence links work
- Owner controls require authorization

Stop after Gate 9.

==================================================
GATE 10 — IOS AUTONOMOUS CONTROLS QA
==================================================

Start only after Gate 9 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

Run the same control tests on iOS.

If a physical iOS device or build is unavailable:

- Report BLOCKED
- State the exact blocker
- Do not mark PASS from configuration inspection alone

Stop after Gate 10.

==================================================
GATE 11 — WEB AUTONOMOUS CONTROLS QA
==================================================

Start only after Gate 10 is VERIFIED or honestly BLOCKED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

Test:

- Dashboard load
- Task creation
- Approval
- Rejection
- Pause
- Resume
- Cancel
- Retry
- Evidence
- Commit
- Deployment
- Filters
- Refresh
- Direct route
- Session restart
- Responsive mobile web
- Browser back/forward

Browsers:

- Chrome
- Edge
- Safari or equivalent
- Android Chrome

Stop after Gate 11.

==================================================
GATE 12 — OWNER CONTROL-PLANE CLEANUP
==================================================

This gate includes manual owner actions.

Current blockers:

- Git remote still routes through a Rork-controlled proxy.
- Credentials may have been exposed through prior access.
- Rork access has not been fully revoked across all platforms.

Required owner-side actions:

1. Change Git origin to the direct owner GitHub repository.
2. Remove the Rork Git router and URL rewrite rules.
3. Reconnect Render directly to owner GitHub.
4. Rotate GitHub credentials.
5. Rotate Render credentials.
6. Rotate Supabase credentials.
7. Rotate AWS credentials.
8. Rotate AI-provider credentials.
9. Rotate Expo/EAS credentials.
10. Revoke Rork human access.
11. Revoke Rork service accounts.
12. Remove Rork deploy keys.
13. Remove Rork webhooks.
14. Remove active Rork sessions.
15. Purge exposed tokens from Git history where confirmed.

Required final values:

RORK GIT REMOTES: 0
RORK GIT PROXIES: 0
RORK URL REWRITE RULES: 0
RORK HUMAN ACCESS: 0
RORK SERVICE ACCESS: 0
RORK DEPLOYMENT ACCESS: 0
OLD HIGH-RISK CREDENTIALS ACTIVE: 0

Do not claim this gate complete from inside the Rork sandbox.

==================================================
FINAL PRODUCTION RECONCILIATION
==================================================

After all gates return:

GITHUB HEAD:
RENDER LIVE COMMIT:
PRODUCTION /health COMMIT:
WORKER COMMIT:
SCHEDULER COMMIT:
EXPO BUILD COMMIT:
ALL COMMITS MATCH:

TOTAL ACCEPTANCE CONDITIONS:
VERIFIED:
PARTIAL:
BLOCKED:
FAILED:
NOT TESTED:

Required final values:

TOTAL ACCEPTANCE CONDITIONS: 33
VERIFIED: 33
PARTIAL: 0
FAILED: 0
NOT TESTED: 0

BLOCKED may be greater than zero only when an explicit owner action remains. In that case, do not report 100%.

==================================================
FINAL VERDICT RULE
==================================================

Only use:

VERIFIED — AUTONOMOUS SYSTEM 100% ACCEPTED

when all 33 conditions are VERIFIED with current evidence.

Otherwise use:

PARTIAL — REMAINING GAPS LISTED
BLOCKED — OWNER ACTION REQUIRED
FAILED — ACCEPTANCE NOT MET

==================================================
RESPONSE FORMAT FOR EACH GATE
==================================================

1. GATE NUMBER AND NAME
2. DIRECT RESULT
3. CURRENT DEFECT
4. ROOT CAUSE
5. FILES INSPECTED
6. FILES CHANGED
7. DATABASE CHANGES
8. TESTS
9. PRODUCTION EVIDENCE
10. COMMIT SHA
11. DEPLOYMENT ID
12. FAILED ITEMS
13. BLOCKED ITEMS
14. GATE ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST
15. GATE VERDICT

STOP AFTER EACH GATE.

Do not start the next gate until the owner confirms the previous gate is accepted.
